Aabb2.containsBox: True when this box fully covers `other` on both axes.

ArcPolyline2.lengthTable: Partial sums of the segment lengths: k + 1 values, starting at 0.

ArcPolyline2.normalAtLength: Unit left normal: the tangent turned counter-clockwise.
ArcPolyline2.offset: The path moved `distance` to the left (negative: right).
ArcPolyline2.sagittas: One per segment; exactly 0 for a straight segment.
